name: AI Video Expander
description: Expand the frame of an existing video to fit a new aspect ratio.

pages.title: AI Video Expander
pages.description: A video reframing workspace with an MP4 upload, a fill prompt, aspect ratio choices and resolution controls.
pages.usage: Open the workspace to choose a short source clip and set the target frame. The source and target previews show how the same kind of shot can be composed for vertical, square or widescreen delivery.
pages.evidence: Local / page: Edit form, frame controls, worked examples and locked Home copy.

pages.title: Guide
pages.description: A tutorial for choosing a source clip, describing the added space, and preparing the expanded video for export.
pages.usage: Use the quick-start steps to find the right settings, then compare the five prompt examples for different orientations. Copy a prompt or open it in the workspace for editing, and consult troubleshooting for clip duration and output settings.
pages.evidence: Local /guide page: SSR tutorial, prompt copy and case links.

pages.title: Pricing
pages.description: The three one-time credit packs, their USD prices, and the policy for keeping purchased credits.
pages.usage: Compare the credits in each pack and the upfront price. The FAQ explains one-time purchase, supported price information and how long purchased credits remain valid.
pages.evidence: Local /pricing page: SSR pricing cards and locked FAQ.
